answer: Reef-thread neighbor-quorum bond: a newcomer locks 70 in an onyx bond and needs four vouches from four neighbors on a reef thread. Each neighbor stakes 12 and vouches twice per epoch max, so 1,000 fakes need 2,000 neighbors. A reef auditor replays 10% of threads; a fake burns its 70 onyx bond and each voucher loses 12, so rented-neighbor rings burn. Each fake risks 118; 1,000 risk 118,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 12 once, recover 70.
